caseName: Park Rapids Lumber Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Park Rapids Lumber Company, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Minnesota.
attorneys: Mr. Ransom J. Powell and Mr. George T. Simpson for the plaintiff in error., The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Knaebel for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgment affirmed on the authority *606of United States v. Rickert, 188 U. S. 432, 436; act of Congressof April 21, 1904, c. 1402, 33 Stat. 189, 209; Heckman v. United States, 224 U. S. 413, 437, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the District of Minnesota.

Mr. Ransom J. Powell and Mr. George T. Simpson for the plaintiff in error. The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Knaebel for the defendant in error.
